name: Gaal
bio: Gaal was the son of Ebed. Three years into Abimelech's reign over Shechem, the Shechemites' hearts turned against him; Gaal arrived with his brothers, and the Shechemites placed their confidence in him. At a feast, Gaal openly mocked Abimelech: "Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should be subject to him? Isn't he Jerubbaal's son, and isn't Zebul his deputy?" boasting that if the people would follow him, he could drive Abimelech out (Judges 9:26-29). Abimelech's officer Zebul learned of this and set an ambush by night; the next morning, as Gaal came out of the city, Zebul's forces attacked and routed Gaal's men, and Zebul then drove Gaal and his brothers out of Shechem for good (Judges 9:34-41).
